text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2022.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2022

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi sembilan belas juta satu ratus

dua puluh lima ribu ringgit (RM19,125,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial

Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2022 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

 (RM)

Emolumen 4,062,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 5,029,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,982,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 8,052,000

______________

JUMLAH 19,125,000

Dibuat 28 Oktober 2022

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(24); PN(PU2)744/JLD. 4]

 DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2022

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2022.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2022

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding nineteen million one hundred and twenty-five

thousand ringgit (RM19,125,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on the administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme for

the year 2022 is hereby authorized for the purpose specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

 (RM)

Emoluments 4,062,000

Supplies and services 5,029,000

Other expenditures 1,982,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 8,052,000

 ______________

 TOTAL 19,125,000

Made 28 October 2022

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(24); PN(PU2)744/JLD. 4]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
